q1.sampleAnswer: It is located in southwest Indiana.

keyPoints.descZh: 位于印第安纳州西南部

q1.rubricZh: 要点：位于印第安纳州西南部。
q1.explanationZh: 第二段说 1854 年一群人在印第安纳州西南部建了这个小镇（最初叫 Santa Fe，后来改名 Santa Claus）。

evidence.quote: In 1854, a group of people settled in southwest Indiana and set up a town called Santa Fe.

q2.sampleAnswer: Because there was already another town named Santa Fe in Indiana with a post office, and they had to change the name to get a post office.

keyPoints.descZh: 已经有另一个叫 Santa Fe 的镇有邮局
examples: another Santa Fe with a post office

q2.rubricZh: 要点：印第安纳州已有一个叫 Santa Fe 的镇并且有邮局；新镇要改名才能有邮局。
q2.explanationZh: 第二段说新镇申请邮局被拒，因为已经有另一个 Santa Fe 有邮局了，所以必须换名字才能得到邮局。

evidence.quote: The new Santa Fe would need a new name in order to be given a post office.

q3.rubricZh: 要点：1856 年的圣诞节早晨。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说圣诞节早晨小镇选好了新名字；第二段说两年后（即 1856 年）申请邮局被拒，所以是 1856 年圣诞节早晨。

evidence.quote: by Christmas morning, the town had chosen its new name
when they applied to get a post office two years later

q4.sampleAnswer: Because he didn’t think his handwriting was good and he believed using a number could reduce the problem of illegibility on mail.

keyPoints.descZh: 他觉得自己的字写得不好
examples: didn’t think his handwriting was good

keyPoints.descZh: 用数字能减少信件字迹模糊的问题
examples: a number could reduce the problem of illegibility on mail

q4.rubricZh: 要点：他觉得自己字写得不好；用数字可以减少信件上字迹模糊的问题。
q4.explanationZh: 第四段说 Nunnally 对自己的字没信心，觉得用数字当镇名，信上的字迹就不容易看不清。

evidence.quote: Nunnally didn’t think highly of his handwriting.
He thought that using a number as the town’s name would make illegibility on mail less of an issue.

q5.sampleAnswer: Two bells and the words “Ding Dong” under the bells.
q5.rubricZh: 要点：两个铃铛；铃铛下面写着“Ding Dong”。
q5.explanationZh: 第五段说 Hoover 在招牌上画了两个铃铛，并在铃铛下写了 “Ding Dong”。

evidence.quote: Hoover drew two bells on the sign and wrote “Ding Dong” under the bells.

q6.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do. I think it is always meaningful to learn more about the history of a particular place. It is these historical stories that make the place different from many other places on Earth.(Answers may vary.)

examples: It is always meaningful to learn more about the history of a particular place.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题：明确表态（值得/不值得），并给出合理理由即可。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题。先说值得还是不值得，再给理由，比如这些故事能让我们了解一个地方的历史和文化。

evidence.quote: Dabnie Nunnally, the town’s first postmaster, came up with the name.

q7.explanationZh: 空前是形容词 economic，后面要名词。grow 的名词是 growth，意思是“经济增长”。

q8.explanationZh: It would be ___ to do... 要用形容词，use 的形容词是 useful（有用的）。
q8.tipsZh: It would be + 形容词 + to do sth.

q9.explanationZh: 空前有冠词 a，要填名词。decide 的名词是 decision（决定），arrive at a decision 意思是“做出决定”。
q9.tipsZh: arrive at a decision 得出决定

q10.explanationZh: 这里说电影结局比想象的更“令人兴奋”，描述事物用 exciting，不用 excited（感到兴奋的，修饰人）。
q10.tipsZh: -ing 形容词说事物，-ed 形容词说人的感受

q11.explanationZh: 空前是 many，空后是名词 faces，要填形容词。strangely 是副词，对应的形容词是 strange（陌生的）。

q12.explanationZh: “成立自己的公司”用 set up，be going to 后面接动词原形，所以是 set up his own company。

q13.explanationZh: “成长过程”是 the process of growing up。of 后面接动名词，所以用 growing up。

accept: He turned down the job offer

q14.explanationZh: 句子要有主语 He，“拒绝”用 turned down，句子用过去时。

accept: think highly of his research work
speak highly of his research work
spoke highly of his research work
thought highly of his research work

q15.explanationZh: “倍加赞赏”可以用 think highly of（高度评价）。we all 后面用一般现在时，所以是 think highly of his research work。
q15.tipsZh: think highly of 对……评价很高

accept: come up with any solution to the problem
come up with a solution to the problem

q16.explanationZh: “想出办法”用 come up with。官方答案按此给出（注意：书中空格前印有 to，是原书排印问题）。
q16.tipsZh: come up with 想出（办法）
